versions.content: } When entering the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_ READY_SLEEP from COMM_PNC_ REQUESTED, the API Com_SendSignal() shall be called with the value ‘0’ for the bit representing this PNC for all Com signals assigned to this PNC with ComMPncComSignalDirection “TX”.

When entering the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_READY_SLEEP from COMM_PNC_REQUESTED, then the PNC bit representing this PNC within the IRA shall be set to value ‘0’ and the aggregated internal PNC requests shall be forwarded to each channel which is referenced b y this PNC by calling Nm_UpdateIRA ( <channel>, <IRA> )
